program = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The divider separates the sample objects from the reference at the bottom.
    div = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == row[0] and row[0] != 0 for v in row))
    ref_color = next(v for row in grid[div+1:] for v in row if v)
    ref_pts = [(r, c) for r in range(div+1, h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == ref_color]
    rr0, rr1 = min(r for r,c in ref_pts), max(r for r,c in ref_pts)
    rc0, rc1 = min(c for r,c in ref_pts), max(c for r,c in ref_pts)
    # Keep the lower reference in the cropped region below the divider.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid[div+1:]]
    # Rightmost of the three upper objects is the one paired with the reference.
    colors = {v for row in grid[:div] for v in row if v}
    comps = []
    for color in colors:
        pts = [(r,c) for r in range(div) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if pts:
            comps.append((max(c for r,c in pts), color, pts))
    _, chosen, pts = max(comps)
    pr0, pc0 = min(r for r,c in pts), min(c for r,c in pts)
    # Colors below the divider's color are placed above the reference; higher colors below it.
    place_above = chosen < grid[div][0]
    target_start = rr0 - div - 1
    dest_start = target_start - (pr0 and 0) # initialized below; shapes are stacked by their 3-row boxes
    dest_start = target_start - (rr1-rr0+1) if place_above else target_start + (rr1-rr0+1)
    dest_col = rc0
    minrow = min(0, dest_start)
    maxrow = max(len(out)-1, dest_start + (max(r for r,c in pts)-pr0))
    if minrow < 0:
        out = [[0]*w for _ in range(-minrow)] + out
        target_start -= minrow
        dest_start -= minrow
        maxrow -= minrow
    if maxrow >= len(out):
        out.extend([[0]*w for _ in range(maxrow+1-len(out))])
    for r,c in pts:
        out[dest_start + (r-pr0)][dest_col + (c-pc0)] = chosen
    return out
'''

program = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    div = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == row[0] and row[0] != 0 for v in row))
    ref_color = next(v for row in grid[div+1:] for v in row if v)
    ref_pts = [(r, c) for r in range(div+1, h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == ref_color]
    rr0, rr1 = min(r for r,c in ref_pts), max(r for r,c in ref_pts)
    rc0 = min(c for r,c in ref_pts)
    colors = {v for row in grid[:div] for v in row if v}
    comps = []
    for color in colors:
        pts = [(r,c) for r in range(div) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if pts:
            comps.append((max(c for r,c in pts), color, pts))
    _, chosen, pts = max(comps)
    pr0, pc0 = min(r for r,c in pts), min(c for r,c in pts)
    target_start = rr0 - div - 1
    span = rr1 - rr0 + 1
    row_span = max(r for r,c in pts) - pr0 + 1
    above = chosen < grid[div][0]
    dest_start = target_start - row_span if above else target_start + span
    if dest_start < 0 or dest_start + row_span > 9:
        above = not above
        dest_start = target_start - row_span if above else target_start + span
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(9)]
    for r,c in ref_pts:
        out[r - div - 1][c] = ref_color
    for r,c in pts:
        out[dest_start + (r-pr0)][rc0 + (c-pc0)] = chosen
    return out
'''

        pts = [(r,c) for r in range(div) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        comps.append((max(c for r,c in pts), color, pts))
    _, chosen, pts = max(comps)
    pr0, pc0 = min(r for r,c in pts), min(c for r,c in pts)
    target_start = rr0 - div - 1
    ref_h = rr1 - rr0 + 1
    obj_h = max(r for r,c in pts) - pr0 + 1
    above = chosen < grid[div][0]

    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(9)]

    for r,c in pts:
        out[dest_start + (r-pr0)][rc0 + (c-pc0)] = chosen
    return out
'''
